description: A string type built with backticks and placeholders, e.g. `` `btn-${Size}` ``.
Unions inside placeholders expand into every combination of their members.
`Uppercase`, `Lowercase`, `Capitalize` and `Uncapitalize` transform string literal types; they are implemented by the compiler.
`S extends `${infer A}.${infer B}`` parses a string literal type into parts; `infer N extends number` converts a part into a number literal.
